worked_solution:
Since the given series is in the form ${\sum }_{n=1}^{N}{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1},$ it is a geometric series. 

To determine the sum, we use the formula for the sum ${S}_{N}$ of a geometric series.

$$
{S}_{N}={a}_{1}\frac{(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=9,$ $r=3$ and $N=6.$ If we substitute these values into the formula for ${S}_{N}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{n=1}^{6}9(3)^{n-1} & =9\cdot \frac{(1-{3}^{6})}{1-3} \\  & =-\frac{9}{2}(-728) \\  & =3\,276\end{aligned}
$$
